skills.name: aseprite-accessibility-review
skills.description: Review Aseprite assets for visual accessibility risks. Use when contrast, color-only communication, motion readability, rapid flashing, small silhouettes, or palette variants need evidence-based assessment.

skills.name: aseprite-animation-cleanup
skills.description: Clean and stabilize existing Aseprite animation frames. Use for jitter, inconsistent timing, stray pixels, rough inbetweens, broken arcs, baseline drift, or loop seams after the main motion is authored.

skills.name: aseprite-animation-event-authoring
skills.description: Author structured gameplay and audio events on Aseprite animation frames. Use when footsteps, impacts, hitboxes, projectiles, sounds, particles, or state transitions must align with final frame timing.

skills.name: aseprite-animation-review
skills.description: Review Aseprite pixel-art animations for timing, motion, visual consistency, duplicate or empty frames, baseline drift, and export readiness. Use when evaluating or correcting an existing animation rather than creating its initial art direction.

skills.name: aseprite-atlas-production
skills.description: Normalize, validate, and pack multiple Aseprite assets into deterministic atlases. Use when a bounded asset set must share export rules and produce one PNG texture with machine-readable metadata.

skills.name: aseprite-autotile-authoring
skills.description: Plan and author seamless Aseprite terrain autotiles with complete edge, corner, transition, and adjacency coverage. Use for rule-driven terrain sets, not ordinary standalone tiles.

skills.name: aseprite-batch-asset-pipeline
skills.description: Apply a consistent inspection, validation, naming, and export contract across multiple Aseprite assets. Use for bounded asset batches with an explicit output convention, not for unrelated bulk filesystem changes.

skills.name: aseprite-bitmap-font-production
skills.description: Design and prepare bitmap font sprite assets in Aseprite. Use when glyph coverage, cell grids, baseline, spacing, punctuation, accents, and engine-ready extraction metadata matter.

skills.name: aseprite-character-animation-set
skills.description: Plan, produce, and validate a coherent family of character animations in Aseprite. Use when idle, movement, combat, reaction, and death states must share proportions, anchors, timing conventions, and export metadata.

skills.name: aseprite-collision-shape-authoring
skills.description: Derive and refine game collision geometry from Aseprite assets. Use when rectangles or contour polygons must balance visual fit, stability, and runtime cost.

skills.name: aseprite-color-managed-export
skills.description: Prepare color-managed Aseprite assets for reliable handoff. Use when sRGB assignment, ICC conversion, profile provenance, or cross-application color consistency matters.

skills.name: aseprite-color-variant-production
skills.description: Create controlled costume, team, enemy, or biome color variants from an Aseprite source while preserving material separation, contrast, transparency, and animation structure.

skills.name: aseprite-concept-to-sprite
skills.description: Translate reference or concept art into an editable Aseprite pixel-art sprite or animation. Use when proportions, silhouette, palette roles, layers, and motion must be planned from a visual reference before production edits begin.

skills.name: aseprite-cutscene-animation-production
skills.description: Produce timed pixel-art cutscene animation in Aseprite. Use for dialogue beats, staged actions, camera plates, or scripted sequences with event and duration contracts.

skills.name: aseprite-directional-animation
skills.description: Produce consistent four-way or eight-way character animations in Aseprite. Use when direction-specific silhouettes, mirrored reuse, anchors, timing, equipment, and tag naming must remain coherent.

skills.name: aseprite-document-optimization
skills.description: Reduce avoidable Aseprite document weight without changing intended artwork or timing. Use for duplicate cel images, empty bounds, excess palette entries, or release-size cleanup.

skills.name: aseprite-engine-export-profile
skills.description: Translate an explicit game-engine asset schema into Aseprite validation and export operations. Use for Godot, Unity, or custom pipelines with required dimensions, names, tags, pivots, slices, palettes, and atlas metadata.

skills.name: aseprite-environment-prop-production
skills.description: Produce game-ready pixel-art environment props in Aseprite. Use when an object needs state variants, damage stages, interaction animation, pivots, slices, collision masks, or atlas-ready exports.

skills.name: aseprite-fighting-game-animation
skills.description: Plan, build, and review frame-data-driven fighting-game animations in Aseprite. Use for attacks, movement, reactions, and combat readability involving startup, active, recovery, hitbox, or hurtbox timing.

skills.name: aseprite-game-export
skills.description: Prepare and export editable Aseprite assets for a game engine. Use when tags, slices, pivots, properties, frame dimensions, sprite sheets, and machine-readable metadata must be validated and handed off consistently.

skills.name: aseprite-isometric-tile-production
skills.description: Build and validate isometric pixel-art tile families in Aseprite. Use when diamond projection, elevation steps, shared edges, occlusion, anchors, and engine-specific tile ordering must remain consistent.

skills.name: aseprite-looping-background-production
skills.description: Produce seamless looping pixel-art backgrounds in Aseprite. Use for animated skies, water, weather, machinery, parallax strips, or ambient environmental cycles.

skills.name: aseprite-modular-character-production
skills.description: Produce layer-compatible modular characters in Aseprite. Use for paper dolls, equipment swaps, armor sets, hair variants, or independently composited body parts.

skills.name: aseprite-modular-variant-export
skills.description: Export controlled layer combinations from Aseprite. Use for equipment sets, paper dolls, portraits, skins, UI states, or other named variants composed from shared layers.

skills.name: aseprite-nine-slice-ui-production
skills.description: Create and validate scalable nine-slice pixel-art UI assets in Aseprite. Use for panels, buttons, frames, and controls whose corners and borders must survive multiple target sizes.

skills.name: aseprite-palette-cycle-production
skills.description: Build and verify indexed-color palette-cycle animations in Aseprite. Use for water, fire, lights, energy, conveyor, or ambient motion driven by rotating palette indices instead of redrawing pixels.

skills.name: aseprite-palette-design
skills.description: Design, apply, and review compact role-based palettes for Aseprite pixel art. Use when reducing colors, establishing ramps, improving contrast, creating variants, or converting an asset to indexed color.

skills.name: aseprite-pixel-art-qa
skills.description: Audit Aseprite pixel art for cluster quality, stray pixels, silhouette readability, palette consistency, frame continuity, and production defects. Use for quality review rather than initial art direction.

skills.name: aseprite-pixel-art-restoration
skills.description: Restore damaged, scaled, compressed, or off-palette pixel art in Aseprite while preserving the original design. Use when cleanup must remove resampling artifacts without stylistic redesign.

skills.name: aseprite-platformer-character-production
skills.description: Produce and validate pixel-art platformer character animation sets in Aseprite. Use for grounded movement, jump phases, attacks, reactions, collision, pivots, and gameplay event timing.

skills.name: aseprite-portrait-expression-production
skills.description: Produce consistent pixel-art portrait expression sets in Aseprite. Use for dialogue faces, emotion variants, blinking, lip shapes, or character reaction portraits that must retain identity.

skills.name: aseprite-release-asset-audit
skills.description: Perform final release audits of Aseprite asset sets. Use when documents, palettes, animation events, frames, slices, collisions, exports, atlases, and manifests must be checked before handoff.

skills.name: aseprite-retro-hardware-constraint-production
skills.description: Produce Aseprite assets for explicit retro hardware limits. Use when palettes, tile budgets, sprite sizes, scanline limits, banks, or attribute regions must match a target platform.

skills.name: aseprite-rpg-icon-set-production
skills.description: Produce coherent RPG item, ability, status, and inventory icon sets in Aseprite. Use when many small icons must share a grid, palette, silhouette language, and export contract.

skills.name: aseprite-shared-asset-library-production
skills.description: Maintain reusable Aseprite layer and group libraries. Use when effects, equipment, UI parts, poses, or other image-layer trees must move safely between compatible documents.

skills.name: aseprite-sprite-production
skills.description: Produce and refine editable pixel-art sprites and animations with the Aseprite MCP server. Use when creating an Aseprite document, importing a sprite sheet, matching concept art, editing pixels/frames/layers/tags, applying a palette, transforming cels, reviewing animation quality, or exporting game-ready sprite sheets.

skills.name: aseprite-tile-metadata-authoring
skills.description: Author engine-facing properties on Aseprite tiles and tilesets. Use when terrain types, collisions, costs, variants, triggers, or adjacency semantics must accompany tile pixels.

skills.name: aseprite-tilemap-level-production
skills.description: Build and exchange tilemap level layouts in Aseprite. Use when tile layers, transforms, engine JSON, round trips, or level-data validation matter beyond tileset artwork itself.

skills.name: aseprite-tileset-production
skills.description: Build and refine bounded Aseprite tilesets for tile-based games. Use when creating tile dimensions, reusable tile images, seamless variants, palette consistency, or tileset metadata; do not use for ordinary character animation.

skills.name: aseprite-top-down-character-production
skills.description: Produce directional top-down character sprites and animations in Aseprite. Use when camera angle, directional silhouettes, equipment layers, pivots, interactions, and export ordering must remain coherent.

skills.name: aseprite-ui-sprite-production
skills.description: Produce pixel-art UI icons, controls, panels, state animations, pivots, and nine-slice metadata in Aseprite. Use for interface assets where fixed borders and scalable centers matter.

skills.name: aseprite-vfx-production
skills.description: Create and refine pixel-art visual effects in Aseprite. Use for impacts, trails, fire, smoke, magic, particles, explosions, and other looping or one-shot effects where timing, value, and silhouette drive readability.
